ponobbhavika.p: [ punabbhava + ika. Ponabhavika-saṃ ] (ti) Google Translate Over and over again - the trouble of life - which causes life - to be born in life - Again, life-doing-giving, Again, life-gives-for life's sake, Again, worthy of the benefit of life, In doing life again, (Craving, Sangha, Karma-etc.)

R:
ponobbhavika：ပေါနောဗ်ဘဝိက （တိ） （ပုနဗ်ဘဝ+ဏိက）
တစ်ဖန်ဘဝသစ်၌ ဖြစ်စေတတ်သော။ ဘဝသစ်ကို ဖြစ်စေတတ်သော။
DOP: pono(b)bhavika ponabbhavika punabbhavika mfn. [ BHS paunarbhavika], leading to rebirth, to renewed existence; Vin I 10, 31 (idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ, yāyaṃ taṇhā ~ā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatrābhinandinī) ≠ M I 48, 36 = Vibh 101, 23 (Vibh-a 110, 29 foll.: ~ā ti punabbhavakaraṇaṃ punobhavo, punobhavo sīlaṃ assā ti ~ā, api ca punabbhavaṃ deti punabbhavāya saṃvattati punappunaṃ bhave nibbattetī ti ~ā); A II 11, 13 (saṃyutto pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi saṅkilesikehi ~ehi sadarehi dukkhavipākehi; Mp III 14, 26 : punabbhavanibbattakehi); Paṭis II 127, 8 (ye ca saṅkhārā ~ā; Paṭis-a 603, 10 : punabbhavo sīlaṃ etesan ti ponabbhavikā, ponabbhavikā eva ~ā); Peṭ 219, 19 (~ā ṭhiti, Be, Ce so; Ee ponabbhavikā); Vism 583, 6 (bālo punabbhavikehi saṅkhārehi attānaṃ veṭheti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ponabbhavikehi); It-a I 152, 22 (pāpaṃ … punappunaṃ bhavadukkhanibbattanato ~aṃ).

poṅkha.cp: . = puṅkha, the feathered part of an arrow.
poṅkha.p: [ puma + khanu + kvi. Sī, bhāsā, ṭī, 3. 19. (puṅkha-saṃ) ] (na) Google Translate Arrow - tail - leaf Arrow tail.

C: poṅkha：[nt．] the feathered part of an arrow．
P: Poṅkha，[increment form of puṅkha] arrow，only in redupl．（iterative） cpd．Poṅkh’ânupoṅkhaṁ （adv．） arrow after arrow，shot after shot，i．e．constantly，continuously S．V，453，454； Nd2 631 （in def．of sadā）； DA．I，188； VvAh 351．The expln is problematic．（Page 474）
DOP: poṅkha m.n. [= puṅkha qv ], (the shaft or feathered part of) an arrow; Spk III 301, 21 (yathā aparassa ~aṃ vijjhati … dutiyassa ~aṃ, Ee so; Be assa sarassa ~aṃ vijjhati; Ce, Se aparantassa vijjhati); Mhv 25:99 (taṃ saraṃ … ṭhapāpetvā ~ena ujukaṃ tale, Ee so; Be puṃkhena); — ifc see nārāca-; — ° ânupoṅkhaṃ , adv. , shaft into shaft, one arrow into another; one after another, continuously; S V 453, 11 (addasā kho āyasmā Ānando sambahule Licchavikumārake … upāsanaṃ karonte dūrato va sukhumena tāḷacchiggaḷena asanaṃ atipātente ~aṃ avirādhitaṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee poṅkhānupoṅkaṃ; Se pokhānupokhaṃ; Spk III 301, 20 foll.: ekaṃ kaṇḍaṃ khipitvā yathā aparassa poṅkhaṃ vijjhati, aparaṃ anupoṅkhaṃ nāma dutiyassa poṅkhaṃ, puna aparaṃ tassa poṅkhan ti evaṃ atipātente addasa, Ee so; Be assa sarassa poṅkhaṃ vijjhati; Ce, Se yathā aparantassa vijjhati, aparaṃ poṅkhaṃ nāma dutiyassa poṅkhaṃ puna aparamanupoṅkhaṃ puna aparaṃ tassa poṅkhan ti; Spk-ṭ [ Be ] II 545, 9 foll. ); Nidd I 18, 26 (sadā sabbadā … abbokiṇṇaṃ ~aṃ …, Be, Ce so; Ee abbocchiṇṇaṃ; Se pokhānupokhaṃ; Nidd-a I 79, 34 : paṭipātiyā ghaṭitaṃ); Sv 188, 7 (~aṃ upaṭṭhahamānaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā va āgacchati; Sv-pṭ I 318, 4 foll.: ~an ti kammaṭṭhānupaṭṭhānassa avicchedadassanaṃ etaṃ, yathā ~aṃ pavattāya sarapaṭipāṭiyā avicchedo); Ud-a 267, 8 (te [guṇā] anekasatā anekasahassā ~aṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsu); 337, 8 (tāni nirantaraṃ ~aṃ … upaṭṭhahiṃsu).

poṇa.cp: adj. sloping down; prone; covering or leading to.
poṇa.p: [ pū +ṇa. Nīti, dhā. 252. Pravaṇa - saṃ ] (ti) Google Translate (1) Leaning. (2) the valley, Low. (3) Purifying.

C: poṇa：[adj．] sloping down； prone； covering or leading to．
P: Poṇa，2 （adj．） [fr．pa+ava+nam，cp．ninna & Vedic pravaṇa] 1．sloping down，prone，in anupubba° gradually sloping （of the ocean） Vin．II，237=A．IV，198 sq．=Ud．53．-- 2．（-°） sloping towards，going to，converging or leading to Nibbāna； besides in var．phrases，in general as tanninna tappoṇa tappabbhāra，“leading to that end．” As nibbāna° e．g．at M．I，493； S．V，38 sq．； A．III，443； cp．Vv 8442 （nekkhamma°-nibbāna-ninna VvA．348）； taṁ° Ps．II，197； ṭhāne PvA．190； viveka° A．IV，224，233； V，175； samādhi° Miln．38； kiṁ° M．I，302．（Page 474）
Poṇa，<sup>1</sup> （nt．） [=poṇa2?] only in cpd．danta° a tooth pick Vin．IV，90； J．IV，69； Miln．15； SnA 272．As dantapoṇaka at Dāvs．I，57．-- kūṭa-poṇa at Vism．268 read °goṇa．（Page 474）

ဒန္တပေါဏ၊ ဒန်ပူ။
